headline: UW-Whitewater closes the season with two defeats
dek: UW-Whitewater paired 44 goals with a defense that allowed fourteen, finishing with ten wins and seven draws alongside those two losses. Even with UW-Platteville finishing unbeaten atop the conference table, UW-Whitewater's stinginess defined the autumn across every match on its schedule.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Scoring sits clustered near the top of the chart, and UW-Platteville won the conference with 38 goals while conceding eighteen rather than leading the league in output.

wire.line: UW-Stevens Point has eleven wins, more than any other program in the conference, despite finishing near the bottom of the table.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three scheduled matches are past their dates with no published result: UW-Eau Claire against North Central and St. Olaf in August, and UW-River Falls against Martin Luther in October.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: UW-Stevens Point forward Jaxon Buckley scored fourteen goals from 55 shots to pace the conference's scoring chart.

last_match.line: The loss ended an unbeaten run stretching back to October and followed a road win at UW-Platteville.
